{"settings":"{
    "editor.fontLigatures": true,
    "editor.fontSize": 18,
    "editor.fontWeight": "normal",
    "security.workspace.trust.untrustedFiles": "open",
    "workbench.iconTheme": "material-icon-theme",
    "files.autoSave": "afterDelay",
    "workbench.startupEditor": "none",
    "editor.inlineSuggest.enabled": true,
    "editor.fontFamily": "Cartograph CF",
    "workbench.colorTheme": "Matugen Dynamic Theme",



    /* 🎨 THE MATUGEN COLOR KEY (ALL SLOTS) 🎨
       Contrast Levels (Backgrounds):
       - DEEPEST: #0d0f06
       - LOW:     #1b1d12
       - NORMAL:  #1f2116
       - HIGH:    #292b20
       - HIGHEST: #34362a
       
       Hue Categories (Accents):
       - PRIMARY: #d9f959        (Main Theme)
       - SECONDARY: #bfcd86    (Sub-Accents)
       - TERTIARY: #abffab      (Pop of color)
    */




    "workbench.colorCustomizations": {
        // --- BASE & WINDOW ---
        "focusBorder":                            "#d9f95955",
        "foreground":                             "#e3e4d3",
        "widget.shadow":                          "#000000AA",
        "selection.background":                   "#d9f95933",
        "descriptionForeground":                  "#c6c9b0AA",
        "errorForeground":                        "#ffb4ab",
        
        "window.activeBorder":                    "#d9f95933",
        "window.inactiveBorder":                  "#00000000",
        
        // --- TEXT ---
        "textLink.foreground":                    "#d9f959",
        "textLink.activeForeground":              "#d0f051",
        "textCodeBlock.background":               "#1b1d12",

        // --- BUTTONS & INPUT ---
        "button.background":                      "#d9f959",
        "button.foreground":                      "#2a3400",
        "button.hoverBackground":                 "#bddc3e",

        "input.background":                       "#292b2055",
        "input.foreground":                       "#e3e4d3",
        "input.border":                           "#45493633",

        // --- SCROLLBAR ---
        "scrollbarSlider.background":             "#d9f95911",
        "scrollbarSlider.hoverBackground":        "#d9f95922",
        "scrollbarSlider.activeBackground":       "#d9f95944",

        // --- ACTIVITY BAR (The Tinted Sidebar) ---
        "activityBar.background":                 "#0a0a0a",
        "activityBar.foreground":                 "#d9f959",
        "activityBar.inactiveForeground":         "#c6c9b066",
        "activityBar.border":                     "#00000000",
        "activityBar.activeBorder":               "#d9f959",
        "activityBarBadge.background":            "#d9f959",
        "activityBarBadge.foreground":            "#2a3400",

        // --- SIDE BAR ---
        "sideBar.background":                     "#0d0f06CC",
        "sideBar.foreground":                     "#e3e4d3CC",
        "sideBar.border":                         "#00000000",
        "sideBarTitle.foreground":                "#d9f959BB",
        "sideBarSectionHeader.background":        "#00000000",
        "sideBarSectionHeader.foreground":        "#e3e4d3",
        "sideBarSectionHeader.border":            "#00000000",

        // --- EDITOR & TABS ---
        "editorGroup.border":                     "#45493611",
        "editorGroupHeader.tabsBackground":       "#0a0a0a",
        "editorGroupHeader.tabsBorder":           "#00000000",
        
        "tab.activeBackground":                   "#121212",
        "tab.activeForeground":                   "#d9f959",
        "tab.activeBorderTop":                    "#d9f959",
        "tab.inactiveBackground":                 "#0a0a0a",
        "tab.inactiveForeground":                 "#c6c9b088",
        "tab.border":                             "#00000000",

        "editor.background":                      "#0d0f06CC",
        "editor.foreground":                      "#e3e4d3CC",
        "editorLineNumber.foreground":            "#c6c9b044",
        "editorLineNumber.activeForeground":      "#d9f959",
        "editorCursor.foreground":                "#d9f959",
        "editor.selectionBackground":             "#d9f95933",
        "editor.lineHighlightBackground":         "#d9f95915",
        "editor.lineHighlightBorder":             "#00000000",

        "editorGutter.background":                "#0f0f0f",
        "editorBracketHighlight.foreground1":     "#d9f959",
        "editorBracketHighlight.foreground2":     "#bfcd86",
        "editorBracketHighlight.foreground3":     "#abffab",

        // --- PANEL & STATUS BAR ---
        "panel.background":                       "#0a0a0a",
        "panel.border":                           "#45493622",
        "panelTitle.activeForeground":            "#d9f959",
        "panelTitle.activeBorder":                "#d9f959",

        "statusBar.background":                   "#d9f959",
        "statusBar.foreground":                   "#2a3400",
        "statusBar.border":                       "#bddc3e",
        "statusBar.noFolderBackground":           "#d9f959",

        "titleBar.activeBackground":              "#050505",
        "titleBar.activeForeground":              "#e3e4d3",
        "titleBar.border":                        "#00000000"
    },

    "editor.tokenColorCustomizations": {
        "textMateRules": [
            {
                "scope": ["comment", "punctuation.definition.comment"],
                "settings": { "foreground": "#c6c9b077", "fontStyle": "italic" }
            },
            {
                "scope": ["keyword", "storage.type", "storage.modifier"],
                "settings": { "foreground": "#d9f959", "fontStyle": "italic" }
            },
            {
                "scope": ["string", "constant.other.symbol", "punctuation.definition.string"],
                "settings": { "foreground": "#bfcd86" }
            },
            {
                "scope": ["entity.name.function", "support.function"],
                "settings": { "foreground": "#abffab" }
            },
            {
                "scope": ["variable", "support.variable"],
                "settings": { "foreground": "#e3e4d3" }
            },
            {
                "scope": ["entity.name.type", "entity.name.class", "support.type", "support.class"],
                "settings": { "foreground": "#d9f959BB" }
            },
            {
                "scope": ["constant.numeric", "constant.language"],
                "settings": { "foreground": "#bfcd86AA" }
            }
        ]
    }
,
  "material-code.primaryColor": "#bddc3e"
}"}
